title: Refactor KMLFile.load() to be asynchronous
description: Fix the race condition in KMLFile.load() by making it async and awaiting all _copyToTmp() calls. Ensure schema files are fully written before schemaExists is set to true.

title: Implement KML specialized node subclasses
description: Create KmlTreeRootNode, KmlFolderNode, and KmlPlacemarkNode in lib/mapping/kml_nodes.dart. These should extend ConcreteTreeNode, ConcreteCompositeNode, and ConcreteLeafNode respectively.

title: Implement iterative KmlParser
description: Implement a strictly iterative (non-recursive) parser using the xml package. Use a stack-based approach to build the tree hierarchy.

title: Handle Longitude/Latitude coordinate swap in KmlParser
description: Ensure the parser correctly transforms KML's Longitude,Latitude coordinate strings into Stager's Latitude,Longitude LatLng objects.

title: Implement memory safety checks for KML parsing
description: Add size limits or warnings when parsing large KML files via the DOM-based xml package to prevent OOM issues on mobile devices.

title: Update public API exports for KML support
description: Update lib/stager.dart to export the new KML node classes and related mapping utilities.

title: Create unit tests for KmlParser
description: Implement tests in test/mapping/kml_parser_test.dart covering coordinate parsing, iterative tree building, and various KML geometries.

title: Create visitor verification test for KML nodes
description: Implement test/tree/kml_visitor_verification_test.dart to ensure NodeVisitor can correctly extract data from KmlPlacemarkNode.

title: Create integration test for KMLFile
description: Implement test/mapping/kml_file_test.dart covering the end-to-end flow from native validation to Stager tree generation.
